credits.title: Cattle Run
credits.overview: Brothers living like strangers for over 30 years, Man-su and Byung-su raise cattle separately but get caught up in an unexpected crisis together.

credits.title: Road to Boston
credits.overview: A rousing tale of the Korean athletes who ran the 1947 Boston International Marathon, the first international marathon held since World War II.

credits.title: Seobok
credits.overview: Ex intelligence agent Ki-heon is tasked with safely transporting Seo Bok, the first ever human clone, who holds the secret of eternal life. Several forces try to take control of Seo Bok to serve their own agendas.

credits.title: Zombie for Sale
credits.overview: When a pharmaceutical company's illegal experiments inadvertently create a zombie, the strange Park family finds it and tries to profit from it.

credits.title: The Divine Move
credits.overview: A professional GO player gathers a team to help him carry out his revenge against the man who killed his brother.

credits.title: A Girl at My Door
credits.overview: Sent from Seoul to serve in a remote coastal village, a policewoman gets involved in the life of a mysterious teenage girl who is abused by both her father and her grandmother.

credits.title: Ice Bar
credits.overview: In 1969, a 10-year old boy's life takes a major turn when he discovers the father he never met is alive. Selling candy bars left and right to save up for a trip to see his dad, the boy embarks on a journey that could change his life forever.

credits.title: The President's Barber
credits.overview: A well-meaning but politically naive barber gets pulled into the inner circle of the South Korean dictator Park Chung-Hee, with rather baleful consequences for his hapless family. This sharp political satire covers roughly twenty years in South Korean political history, from the viewpoint of the barber's son.

credits.title: Lynx 2 - Challenger
credits.overview: Lynx (Kim Jong-Min) Lee Seong-Soon, he defeats Kim Jang-Son in a duel with the pro-Japanese group and flees to Bongcheon wanted for murder.
